From 24055bb87977e0c687b54ebf7bac8715f3636bc3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vladimir Oltean <vladimir.oltean@nxp.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Mar 2022 14:20:12 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net: tcp: fix shim definition of tcp_inbound_md5_hash

When CONFIG_TCP_MD5SIG isn't enabled, there is a compilation bug due to
the fact that the static inline definition of tcp_inbound_md5_hash() has
an unexpected semicolon. Remove it.

Fixes: 1330b6ef3313 ("skb: make drop reason booleanable")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Oltean <vladimir.oltean@nxp.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220309122012.668986-1-vladimir.oltean@nxp.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/include/net/tcp.h b/include/net/tcp.h
index ee8237b58e1d..70ca4a5e330a 100644
--- a/include/net/tcp.h
+++ b/include/net/tcp.h
@@ -1693,7 +1693,7 @@ tcp_md5_do_lookup(const struct sock *sk, int l3index,
 static inline enum skb_drop_reason
 tcp_inbound_md5_hash(const struct sock *sk, const struct sk_buff *skb,
 		     const void *saddr, const void *daddr,
-		     int family, int dif, int sdif);
+		     int family, int dif, int sdif)
 {
 	return SKB_NOT_DROPPED_YET;
 }
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/net/tcp.h`**
   - The function definition of `tcp_inbound_md5_hash` was modified by removing an unexpected semicolon at the end of its declaration. The original declaration had a semicolon, which caused a compilation error when `CONFIG_TCP_MD5SIG` was not enabled. The corrected definition now properly includes the function body.

### Relationships
- The modification in `include/net/tcp.h` addresses a compilation bug that arose from the incorrect function declaration of `tcp_inbound_md5_hash`. This change is directly related to the issue identified in the commit message, which states that the bug was introduced in a previous commit (`1330b6ef3313`). By fixing the function declaration, the patch resolves the compilation issue when the TCP MD5 signature support is not enabled.

net: tcp: fix shim definition of tcp_inbound_md5_hash

When CONFIG_TCP_MD5SIG isn't enabled, there is a compilation bug due to
the fact that the static inline definition of tcp_inbound_md5_hash() has
an unexpected semicolon. Remove it.

Fixes: 1330b6ef3313 ("skb: make drop reason booleanable")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Oltean <vladimir.oltean@nxp.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220309122012.668986-1-vladimir.oltean@nxp.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is the presence of an unexpected semicolon at the end of the static inline function declaration for `tcp_inbound_md5_hash()`. This semicolon causes the function to be incorrectly defined, leading to a compilation error when the `CONFIG_TCP_MD5SIG` option is not enabled, as the function is expected to have a proper implementation rather than just a declaration.

 		     const void *saddr, const void *daddr,
-		     int family, int dif, int sdif);
+		     int family, int dif, int sdif)

 	return SKB_NOT_DROPPED_YET;

```c
		     int family, int dif, int sdif);
```
Reason:
The unexpected semicolon at the end of the function declaration causes it to be treated as a declaration without a proper implementation, leading to a compilation error when `CONFIG_TCP_MD5SIG` is not enabled.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
static inline void tcp_inbound_md5_hash(const struct sock *sk, const struct sk_buff *skb,
		     const void *saddr, const void *daddr,

 {

```
Reason:
